slices.description: Centralize runtime at HOME, track its own lock, and accept an explicit project root.
steps: Tests prove init installs runtime under HARNESS_HOME and creates no project bin directory.
Tests prove centralized harness commands operate on the requested project root without crossing into a second project.
Tests prove runtime version/checksums are stored separately from project locks.

slices.description: Install a shared .agents/skills layout without host recognition.
steps: Tests prove all skills and nested resources install under .agents/skills without an agent argument, prompt, or host detection.
Tests prove fresh installs do not generate .claude/skills, .cursor/skills, .cursor/rules, or CLAUDE.md; role descriptions are stored under harness/agents.
Tests prove doctor/status recognize the shared .agents/skills directory.

slices.description: Separate runtime/project locks and update the common project layout.
steps: Tests prove two project roots update independently through the common managed path.
Tests prove runtime self-update does not store executable checksums in a project lock.
Tests prove edited managed files remain intact and are written to .new on upstream conflict.

slices.description: Harden doctor/status for centralized runtime and shared skills.
steps: Tests prove doctor and status accept explicit project roots from the central runtime.
Tests prove diagnostics report shared skill count, missing skills, manifest health, and runtime/project versions.

slices.description: Safely migrate legacy project executables and host-specific skill files.
steps: Tests prove lock-matching legacy bin scripts, .claude/skills, and generated .cursor/rules are removed or moved to the common path.
Tests prove edited legacy files are preserved and repeated migration is idempotent.

slices.description: Update docs and manifest for centralized runtime and common skills.
steps: Focused searches find no active project-bin command examples or host-specific skill paths/rules guidance.
Full tests and separate L2 evaluation confirm docs match the shared layout and migration behavior.
